title: German Chicken Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting casserole that combines the flavors of Germany with the ease of American cuisine. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the casserole rice according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, sauté the chopped onion, carrot, and celery in easiest american butter until tender.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk and grated cheddar cheese.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked rice, chicken breast, and the milk-cheese mixture.
Add the sautéed vegetables and chopped parsley to the mixing bowl and stir until combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 25-30 minutes or until the casserole is hot and the cheese is melted.
